findings.candidate_quote: The findings highlight observed associations between AXL activity and viral entry and inflammation, without establishing direct causality or clinical implications.
findings.reference_quote: RNA interference-mediated knockdown of AXL also consistently suppressed viral replication (Figures S2a & b, 1 g), whereas AXL overexpression in A549 cells enhanced viral loads (Figures S3a-d, 1 h).
findings.explanation: The closing disclaimer incorrectly reduces manipulated experimental evidence to associations. Knockdown, overexpression, knockout, and inhibition support causal contributions within the tested cell and mouse systems. Lack of demonstrated patient efficacy does not negate that experimental causal evidence.

findings.candidate_quote: The study found observed associations between vaccination and reduced RSV burden but did not establish causality or clinical claims.
findings.reference_quote: Clinical and economic outcomes were projected weekly for each strategy, accounting for infant age, gestational maturity at birth, RSV disease risk, RSV-specific mortality, and maternal immunization status.
findings.explanation: This study generated modeled projections using assumed vaccine effectiveness; it did not observe vaccination–burden associations. Although earlier sentences correctly describe the model, the closing characterization misstates the nature of its evidence.
